import os

def setup_test_env():
    os.makedirs('loglar/eski/derin', exist_ok=True)
    
    # api.log
    with open('loglar/api.log', 'w') as f:
        f.write("2023-01-01 10:00:00 INFO msg\n")
        f.write("2023-01-01 10:01:00 ERROR err_msg\n")
        f.write("2023-01-01 10:02:00 WARN warn_msg\n")
        f.write("2023-01-01 10:03:00 ERROR err_msg\n")

    # web.log (mixed case test)
    with open('loglar/web.log', 'w') as f:
        f.write("2023-01-01 10:00:00 INFO msg\n")
        f.write("2023-01-01 10:01:00 error msg\n") # lowercase ERROR should not count

    # eski/worker.log
    with open('loglar/eski/worker.log', 'w') as f:
        f.write("2023-01-01 10:00:00 INFO msg\n")
        f.write("2023-01-01 10:05:00 ERROR err_msg\n")

    # eski/bos.log (empty)
    open('loglar/eski/bos.log', 'w').close()

    # eski/derin/cron.log
    with open('loglar/eski/derin/cron.log', 'w') as f:
        f.write("2023-01-01 10:00:00 INFO msg\n")
        f.write("2023-01-01 10:00:00 WARN msg\n")
        f.write("2023-01-01 10:00:00 ERROR msg\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    setup_test_env()
